刚来湾区或者刚搬家，很多人都会先看二手。这个思路没问题，特别是桌子、椅子、书架这: Buying used after arriving or moving can be practical, especially for tables, chairs, and bookshelves. The trouble comes from applying the same standard to everything. A bed isn't a table, a refrigerator isn't a microwave, and a washing machine needs an in-person look.
先按品牌和型号查安全警示: Check safety notices by brand and model first
家具和电器能正常用，也先在文末 CPSC 入口按品牌和型号查召回和安全警示；查到: Even if furniture or an appliance works, look up recalls and safety warnings by brand and model through the CPSC link at the end; if the model is listed, read the official remedy before you decide. CPSC consumer hotline: 800-638-2772 (8 a.m.–5:30 p.m. ET).
先分清哪些东西适合买二手，哪些要更谨慎: Decide what is suitable to buy used and what needs extra care
比较适合买二手：桌子、椅子、书架、柜子、餐桌、灯。: Often suitable to buy used: desks, chairs, bookshelves, cabinets, dining tables, and lamps.
可以看情况：床架、沙发、微波炉。: Consider case by case: bed frames, sofas, and microwaves.
要更谨慎：床垫、冰箱、洗衣机、烘干机、大型电器。: Use extra care with mattresses, refrigerators, washers, dryers, and large appliances.
床和床架，重点不一样: A mattress and a bed frame need different checks
床架看稳不稳、缺不缺件、是否好拆装。: Check whether a bed frame is stable, complete, and easy to disassemble and reassemble.
床垫看卫生、异味、塌陷和来源是否清楚。: For mattresses, check cleanliness, odors, sagging, and a clear history.
尺寸要和房间、电梯、车子匹配。: The dimensions need to fit your room, elevator, and vehicle.
搬运当天谁负责下楼和装车。: Who will carry it downstairs and load it on moving day?
桌子、椅子、书架，重点看尺寸和结构: For desks, chairs, and bookshelves, focus on dimensions and construction
这些通常是最适合从二手开始配的。但常见问题不是东西坏，而是买回去放不下、太重、上: These are often good items to start with secondhand. Common problems are not breakage but poor fit, excess weight, difficult stairs, or a mismatch with your room layout.
冰箱和洗衣机，先问功能，再问搬运: For fridges and washers, ask about function before moving logistics
能不能现场通电测试。: Can you plug it in and test it in person?
尺寸能不能进门、电梯和摆放位置。: Will the item fit through doors, into the elevator, and in its intended space?
是否有明显漏水、异响、维修痕迹。: Any obvious leaks, unusual noises, or signs of repair.
插头、进出水接口、安装条件是否匹配。: Do plugs, water connections, and installation requirements match?
搬运成本也要算进总价里: Include transport in the total price
一张便宜桌子，如果你还要临时租车、找人搬、上楼费力，最后不一定真的便宜。尤其冰箱: A cheap desk may not be cheap after renting a vehicle, finding help, and carrying it upstairs. For refrigerators, washing machines, and sofas in particular, moving costs and time often determine whether the deal is worthwhile.
床垫这类贴身、有卫生风险的东西，别只靠几张照片就决定。: For a mattress or anything else with close body contact or hygiene risks, don’t decide from a few photos.
冰箱、洗衣机不能只看照片，要现场通电试一试。: Don’t judge a fridge or washer from photos; plug it in and try it on site.
不能测试功能、来源又说不清的大件家电，通常不值得冒险；便宜不一定真的省。: Large appliances that can’t be tested and have an unclear history usually aren’t worth the risk; a low price doesn’t always save money.
